excerpt.zh: 在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。
excerpt.en: Our infiltrated bodies will need to be placed in strategic locations before we can enact our grand design. Our earlier intel gathering revealed understaffed starbases and poorly defended planets as prime targets. Soon we will get to work.

texts.zh: 在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。
texts.en: Our infiltrated bodies will need to be placed in strategic locations before we can enact our grand design. Our earlier intel gathering revealed understaffed starbases and poorly defended planets as prime targets. Soon we will get to work.

texts.zh: 该工作依然顺利进行着，我们的人发现了更多的宿主，对[Target.GetName]事务的参与已经得到巩固。我们的子个体应该很快就能容纳任何好奇的头脑。
texts.en: The works continues smoothly, our bodies have found more hosts and involvement in [Target.GetName] matters have solidified. Our drones should soon have subsumed any inquisitive minds.

texts.zh: 我们无法替换的[Target.GetSpeciesName]已经从他们的岗位上移除，在[Target.GetName]的结构中创造了许多真空。我们的人偶已经准备好打开全方位渗透的通路，唯一需要做的就是继续执行。
texts.en: The [Target.GetSpeciesName] we couldn't replace have been removed from their positions which has created several vacancies within the [Target.GetName] structure. Our puppets are ready to open the door for our full infiltration, all they need is the go ahead.

texts.zh: [From.Target.GetName]无力抵抗了。他们已经做好了被入侵的准备，我们只需要决定派多少冒名顶替者去进一步渗透他们的帝国。很快都会是[Owner.GetAdj]的。
texts.en: The [From.Target.GetName] have been compromised. They are primed for invasion and all we need to decide is how many imposters we send over to further infiltrate their empire. Soon all will be [Owner.GetAdj].

label.zh: 我们已经尽自己所能派出了。
label.en: We have sent over all we can.

tooltips.zh: 10年内我们对[From.Target.GetName]发动的或他们对我们发动的下一场战争将会充分利用上已经准备好的渗透者。
tooltips.en: The next war we declare against the [From.Target.GetName] or is declared against us within 10 years will make use of our prepared infiltrators.

label.zh: 确保他们的哨站变成我们的。
